adjudication.rationale: In new `TopicEmbed.import`, the URL validation is `return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//` (line ~11). In Ruby, `^` can match after a newline, so a string like `"evil\nhttp://x"` would satisfy the regex even though it’s not a clean URL. That untrusted `url` is then interpolated into HTML (`<a href='#{url}'>`) when appending `imported_from`, so a multiline value can pass the guard and be embedded into rendered HTML.
